```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(forcats)
```

```{r}
file_path = "/srv/shiny-server/snip/processed_data"
load(here(file_path, "weekly_screening.RData"))
```

```{r}
data_week <- weekly_screening %>%
  filter(week == max(week, na.rm = TRUE))
```
## 1. Key Summary (Week r params$week_filter)
```{r}
summary_kpi <- data_week %>%
  summarise(
    Screened = sum(t_screen_scr, na.rm = TRUE),
    Eligible = sum(t_eligible_scr, na.rm = TRUE),
    Enrolled = sum(t_eligible_enrol_scr, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

summary_kpi
```
## 2. Screening Summary per Site
```{r}
summary_data <- data_week %>%
  group_by(Site = site_scr) %>%
  summarise(
    Screened = sum(t_screen_scr, na.rm = TRUE),
    Eligible = sum(t_eligible_scr, na.rm = TRUE),
    Enrolled = sum(t_eligible_enrol_scr, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -Site, names_to = "Status", values_to = "Count") %>%
  mutate(Status = factor(Status, levels = c("Screened","Eligible","Enrolled")))

ggplot(summary_data, aes(x = Status, y = Count, fill = Site)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  geom_text(aes(label = Count), position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), vjust = -0.3) +
  labs(title = "Screening Summary by Site", y = "Count", x = "") +
  theme_minimal()
```
### 3. Weekly Trends
```{r}
trend_data <- weekly_screening %>%
  group_by(week, Site = site_scr) %>%
  summarise(Screened = sum(t_screen_scr, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(trend_data, aes(x = week, y = Screened, color = Site, group = Site)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  labs(title = "Screened Trends by Site", y = "Number Screened", x = "Week") +
  theme_minimal()
```

### 4. Reasons for Non-Eligibility
```{r}
reasons_data <- data_week %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      age_greater_29days_scr,
      sepsis_criteria_not_met_scr,
      other_not_eligible_scr
    ),
    names_to = "Reason",
    values_to = "Count"
  )%>%
  group_by(Reason) %>%
  summarise(Total = sum(Count, na.rm = TRUE)) 

ggplot(reasons_data, aes(x = "", y = Total, fill = Reason)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 1) +
  coord_polar("y") +
  labs(title = "Reasons for Non-Eligibility") +
  theme_void()
```

```{r}
missing_tbl <- data_week %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ mean(is.na(.))*100)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "Variable", values_to = "Missing_Percent") %>%
  arrange(desc(Missing_Percent))
```

```{r}
rooms_per_site <- data_week %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("neo_rm"), names_to = "room_code", values_to = "checked") %>%
  filter(checked == "Checked") %>%
  mutate(room_name = gsub("^neo_rm_[a-z]+_", "", room_code),
         room_name = gsub("_scr$", "", room_name),
         room_name = gsub("_", " ", room_name),
         room_name = tools::toTitleCase(room_name)) %>%
  count(site_scr, room_name) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = site_scr, values_from = n, values_fill = 0)

rooms_per_site
```

```{r}
queries_mismatch <- weekly_screening %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    sum_reasons_not_eligible = sum(
      c_across(c(
        age_greater_29days_scr,
        sepsis_criteria_not_met_scr,
        other_not_eligible_scr,
        other1_not_elig_spec_scr,
        other2_not_elig_spec_scr
      )),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    mismatch_flag = t_not_eligible_scr != sum_reasons_not_eligible
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(mismatch_flag) %>%
  select(record_id,site_scr, week, t_not_eligible_scr, sum_reasons_not_eligible,age_greater_29days_scr,sepsis_criteria_not_met_scr,other_not_eligible_scr,other1_not_elig_spec_scr,other2_not_elig_spec_scr)
```

```{r}
queries_mismatch_not_enrolled <- weekly_screening %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    sum_reasons_not_erolled = sum(
      c_across(c(
        refuse_miss_consent_scr,
        died_scr,
        lama_scr,
        absconded_scr,
        other_not_enrol_scr,
        other1_not_enrol_spec_scr,
        other2_not_enrol_spec_scr
      )),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    mismatch_flag = t_eligible_not_enrol_scr != sum_reasons_not_erolled
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(mismatch_flag) %>%
  select(record_id,site_scr, week, t_eligible_not_enrol_scr, sum_reasons_not_erolled,refuse_miss_consent_scr,died_scr,lama_scr,absconded_scr,other_not_enrol_scr,other1_not_enrol_spec_scr,other2_not_enrol_spec_scr)
```

```{r}
rooms_none_checked_by_site <- weekly_screening %>%
  group_by(site_scr, week) %>%
  filter({
    prefix <- paste0("neo_rm_", tolower(site_scr), "_")
    room_cols <- grep(paste0("^", prefix), names(.), value = TRUE)

    if (length(room_cols) == 0) {
      FALSE  # no room variables for this site
    } else {
      all(across(all_of(room_cols), ~ is.na(.x) | trimws(tolower(.x)) != "checked"))
    }
  }) %>%
  ungroup()
```
